v.t: Those who disbelieve and repel from the path of God—He nullifies their works
v.l: Al-Ladhina Kafaru Wa Saddu `An Sabili Allahi 'Ađalla 'A`malahum
w: He will cause to be lost

v.t: While those who believe, and work righteousness, and believe in what was sent down to Muhammad—and it is the truth from their Lord—He remits their sins, and relieves their concerns
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa `Amilu As-Salihati Wa 'Amanu Bima Nuzzila `Ala Muhammadin Wa Huwa Al-Haqqu Min Rabbihim Kaffara `Anhum Sayyi'atihim Wa 'Aslaha Balahum

v.t: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehoods, while those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. God thus cites for the people their examples
v.l: Dhalika Bi'anna Al-Ladhina Kafaru Attaba`u Al-Batila Wa 'Anna Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Attaba`u Al-Haqqa Min Rabbihim Kadhalika Yađribu Allahu Lilnnasi 'Amthalahum

v.t: When you encounter those who disbelieve, strike at their necks. Then, when you have routed them, bind them firmly. Then, either release them by grace, or by ransom, until war lays down its burdens. Had God willed, He could have defeated them Himself, but He thus tests some of you by means of others. As for those who are killed in the way of God, He will not let their deeds go to waste
v.l: Fa'idha Laqitumu Al-Ladhina Kafaru Fađarba Ar-Riqabi Hatta 'Idha 'Athkhantumuhum Fashuddu Al-Wathaqa Fa'imma Mannaan Ba`du Wa 'Imma Fida'an Hatta Tađa`a Al-Harbu 'Awzaraha Dhalika Wa Law Yasha'u Allahu Lantasara Minhum Wa Lakin Liyabluwa Ba`đakum Biba`đin Wa Al-Ladhina Qutilu Fi Sabili Allahi Falan Yuđilla 'A`malahum
w: surely, He could have taken retribution
He will cause to be lost

v.t: He will guide them, and will improve their state of mind
v.l: Sayahdihim Wa Yuslihu Balahum

v.t: And will admit them into Paradise, which He has identified for them
v.l: Wa Yudkhiluhumu Al-Jannata `Arrafaha Lahum

v.t: O you who believe! If you support God, He will support you, and will strengthen your foothold
v.l: Ya 'Ayyuha Al-Ladhina 'Amanu 'In Tansuru Allaha Yansurkum Wa Yuthabbit 'Aqdamakum

v.t: But as for those who disbelieve, for them is perdition, and He will waste their deeds
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina Kafaru Fata`saan Lahum Wa 'Ađalla 'A`malahum
w: and He will cause to be lost

v.t: That is because they hated what God revealed, so He nullified their deeds
v.l: Dhalika Bi'annahum Karihu Ma 'Anzala Allahu Fa'ahbata 'A`malahum

v.t: Have they not journeyed through the earth and seen the consequences for those before them? God poured destruction upon them, and for the unbelievers is something comparable
v.l: Afalam Yasiru Fi Al-'Arđi Fayanzuru Kayfa Kana `Aqibatu Al-Ladhina Min Qablihim Dammara Allahu `Alayhim Wa Lilkafirina 'Amthaluha

v.t: That is because God is the Master of those who believe, while the disbelievers have no master
v.l: Dhalika Bi'anna Allaha Mawla Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa 'Anna Al-Kafirina La Mawla Lahum

v.t: God will admit those who believe and do good deeds into gardens beneath which rivers flow. As for those who disbelieve, they enjoy themselves, and eat as cattle eat, and the Fire will be their dwelling
v.l: Inna Allaha Yudkhilu Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa `Amilu As-Salihati Jannatin Tajri Min Tahtiha Al-'Anharu Wa Al-Ladhina Kafaru Yatamatta`una Wa Ya'kuluna Kama Ta'kulu Al-'An`am Wa An-Naru Mathwaan Lahum

v.t: How many a town was more powerful than your town which evicted you? We destroyed them, and there was no helper for them
v.l: Wa Ka'ayyin Min Qaryatin Hiya 'Ashaddu Quwatan Min Qaryatika Allati 'Akhrajatka 'Ahlaknahum Fala Nasira Lahum

v.t: Is he who stands upon evidence from his Lord, like someone whose evil deed is made to appear good to him? And they follow their own desires
v.l: Afaman Kana `Ala Bayyinatin Min Rabbihi Kaman Zuyyina Lahu Su'u `Amalihi Wa Attaba`u 'Ahwa'ahum

v.t: The likeness of the Garden promised to the righteous: in it are rivers of pure water, and rivers of milk forever fresh, and rivers of wine delightful to the drinkers, and rivers of strained honey. And therein they will have of every fruit, and forgiveness from their Lord. Like one abiding in the Fire forever, and are given to drink boiling water, that cuts-up their bowels
v.l: Mathalu Al-Jannati Allati Wu`ida Al-Muttaquna Fiha 'Anharun Min Ma'in Ghayri 'Asinin Wa 'Anharun Min Labanin Lam Yataghayyar Ta`muhu Wa 'Anharun Min Khamrin Ladhatin Lilsharibina Wa 'Anharun Min `Asalin Musaffaan Wa Lahum Fiha Min Kulli Ath-Thamarati Wa Maghfiratun Min Rabbihim Kaman Huwa Khalidun Fi An-Nari Wa Suqu Ma'an Hamimaan Faqatta`a 'Am`a'ahum
w: and they will be given to drink

v.t: Among them are those who listen to you, but when they leave your presence, they say to those given knowledge, “What did he say just now?” Those are they whose hearts God has sealed, and they follow their own desires
v.l: Wa Minhum Man Yastami`u 'Ilayka Hatta 'Idha Kharaju Min `Indika Qalu Lilladhina 'Utu Al-`Ilma Madha Qala 'Anifaan 'Ula'ika Al-Ladhina Taba`a Allahu `Ala Qulubihim Wa Attaba`u 'Ahwa'ahum

v.t: As for those who are guided, He increases them in guidance, and He has granted them their righteousness
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhina Ahtadaw Zadahum Hudaan Wa 'Atahum Taqwhum

v.t: Are they just waiting until the Hour comes to them suddenly? Its tokens have already come. But how will they be reminded when it has come to them
v.l: Fahal Yanzuruna 'Illa As-Sa`ata 'An Ta'tiyahum Baghtatan Faqad Ja'a 'Ashratuha Fa'anna Lahum 'Idha Ja'at/hum Dhikrahum

v.t: Know that there is no god but God, and ask forgiveness for your sin, and for the believing men and believing women. God knows your movements, and your resting-place
v.l: Fa`lam 'Annahu La 'Ilaha 'Illa Allahu Wa Astaghfir Lidhanbika Wa Lilmu'uminina Wa Al-Mu'uminati Wa Allahu Ya`lamu Mutaqallabakum Wa Mathwakum

v.t: Those who believe say, “If only a chapter is sent down.” Yet when a decisive chapter is sent down, and fighting is mentioned in it, you see those in whose hearts is sickness looking at you with the look of someone fainting at death. So woe to them
v.l: Wa Yaqulu Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Lawla Nuzzilat Suratun Fa'idha 'Unzilat Suratun Muhkamatun Wa Dhukira Fiha Al-Qitalu Ra'ayta Al-Ladhina Fi Qulubihim Marađun Yanzuruna 'Ilayka Nazara Al-Maghshiyi `Alayhi Mina Al-Mawti Fa'awla Lahum

v.t: Obedience and upright speech. Then, when the matter is settled, being true to God would have been better for them
v.l: Ta`atun Wa Qawlun Ma`rufun Fa'idha `Azama Al-'Amru Falaw Sadaqu Allaha Lakana Khayraan Lahum

v.t: If you turn away, you are likely to make mischief on earth, and sever your family ties
v.l: Fahal `Asaytum 'In Tawallaytum 'An Tufsidu Fi Al-'Arđi Wa Tuqatti`u 'Arhamakum

v.t: Those are they whom God has cursed. He made them deaf, and blinded their sight
v.l: Ula'ika Al-Ladhina La`anahumu Allahu Fa'asammahum Wa 'A`ma 'Absarahum

v.t: Will they not ponder the Quran? Or are there locks upon their hearts
v.l: Afala Yatadabbaruna Al-Qur'ana 'Am `Ala Qulubin 'Aqfaluha

v.t: Those who reverted after the guidance became clear to them—Satan has enticed them, and has given them latitude
v.l: Inna Al-Ladhina Artaddu `Ala 'Adbarihim Min Ba`di Ma Tabayyana Lahumu Al-Huda Ash-Shaytanu Sawwala Lahum Wa 'Amla Lahum

v.t: That is because they said to those who hated what God has revealed, “We will obey you in certain matters.” But God knows their secret thoughts
v.l: Dhalika Bi'annahum Qalu Lilladhina Karihu Ma Nazzala Allahu Sanuti`ukum Fi Ba`đi Al-'Amri Wa Allahu Ya`lamu 'Israrahum

v.t: How about when the angels take them at death, beating their faces and their backs
v.l: Fakayfa 'Idha Tawaffat/humu Al-Mala'ikatu Yađribuna Wujuhahum Wa 'Adbarahum

v.t: That is because they pursued what displeases God, and they disliked His approval, so He nullified their works
v.l: Dhalika Bi'annahumu Attaba`u Ma 'Askhata Allaha Wa Karihu Riđwanahu Fa'ahbata 'A`malahum

v.t: Do those in whose hearts is sickness think that God will not expose their malice
v.l: Am Hasiba Al-Ladhina Fi Qulubihim Marađun 'An Lan Yukhrija Allahu 'Ađghanahum

v.t: Had We willed, We could have shown them to you, and you would have recognized them by their marks. Yet you will recognize them by their tone of speech. And God knows your actions
v.l: Wa Law Nasha'u La'araynakahum Fala`araftahum Bisimahum Wa Lata`rifannahum Fi Lahni Al-Qawli Wa Allahu Ya`lamu 'A`malakum
w: surely, We could show them to you
but surely, you will know them

v.t: We will certainly test you, until We know those among you who strive, and those who are steadfast, and We will test your reactions
v.l: Wa Lanabluwannakum Hatta Na`lama Al-Mujahidina Minkum Wa As-Sabirina Wa Nabluwa 'Akhbarakum
w: And surely We will test you

v.t: Those who disbelieve, and hinder from the path of God, and oppose the Messenger after guidance has become clear to them—they will not hurt God in the least, but He will nullify their deeds
v.l: Inna Al-Ladhina Kafaru Wa Saddu `An Sabili Allahi Wa Shaqqu Ar-Rasula Min Ba`di Ma Tabayyana Lahumu Al-Huda Lan Yađurru Allaha Shay'aan Wa Sayuhbitu 'A`malahum

v.t: O you who believe! obey God, and obey the Messenger, and do not let your deeds go to waste
v.l: Ya 'Ayyuha Al-Ladhina 'Amanu 'Ati`u Allaha Wa 'Ati`u Ar-Rasula Wa La Tubtilu 'A`malakum

v.t: Those who disbelieve, and hinder from God’s path, and then die as disbelievers—God will not forgive them
v.l: Inna Al-Ladhina Kafaru Wa Saddu `An Sabili Allahi Thumma Matu Wa Hum Kuffarun Falan Yaghfira Allahu Lahum

v.t: So do not waver and call for peace while you have the upper hand. God is with you, and He will not waste your efforts
v.l: Fala Tahinu Wa Tad`u 'Ila As-Salmi Wa 'Antumu Al-'A`lawna Wa Allahu Ma`akum Wa Lan Yatirakum 'A`malakum

v.t: The life of this word is nothing but play and pastime. But if you have faith and lead a righteous life, He will grant you your rewards, and He will not ask you for your possessions
v.l: Innama Al-Hayaatu Ad-Dunya La`ibun Wa Lahwun Wa 'In Tu'uminu Wa Tattaqu Yu'utikum 'Ujurakum Wa La Yas'alkum 'Amwalakum

v.t: Were He to ask you for it, and press you, you would become tightfisted, and He would expose your unwillingness
v.l: In Yas'alkumuha Fayuhfikum Tabkhalu Wa Yukhrij 'Ađghanakum
w: He were to ask you for it

v.t: Here you are, being called to spend in the cause of God. Among you are those who withhold; but whoever withholds is withholding against his own soul. God is the Rich, while you are the needy. And if you turn away, He will replace you with another people, and they will not be like you
v.l: Ha'antum Ha'uula' Tud`awna Litunfiqu Fi Sabili Allahi Faminkum Man Yabkhalu Wa Man Yabkhal Fa'innama Yabkhalu `An Nafsihi Wa Allahu Al-Ghaniyu Wa 'Antumu Al-Fuqara'u Wa 'In Tatawallaw Yastabdil Qawmaan Ghayrakum Thumma La Yakunu 'Amthalakum
